s: cloth; piece of fabric or tissue of any kind: scarf, kerchief, blanket, towel, etc.
Tuch.et: From Middle High German tuoch, from Old High German tuoh, from Proto-West Germanic *dōk (“cloth”). Compare Dutch doek (“cloth, canvas”), English duck. More at duck, dook.
